examples.why: The direct object is dropped; "reamostrar" is transitive here and a native technical writer would write "reamostrá-lo". The meaning stays clear from context, so this is a fluency slip rather than drift.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I checked every claim in the last 40% (pure states have one eigenvalue 1 and the rest 0; the global-phase degeneracy argument; the "if and only if" in the final faithful-representation sentence) and found no inversion, no swapped quantity and no hallucinated sentence; core terms are correct and consistent (matriz de densidade, traço, autovalores, posto, medição na base padrão, superposição quântica, fase relativa/global). Four editorial items remain. (1) The cross-reference to the *Single systems* lesson is rendered "Sistemas simples" (= "simple systems", a false friend); the rest of the pt corpus calls that lesson "Sistemas únicos" (twice in entanglement-in-action/qiskit-implementation.mdx), so a learner following the pointer looks for a lesson title that does not exist. (2) In the diagonal-entries bullet, English's deliberately informal gloss "weight" or "likelihood" becomes "peso" ou "probabilidade", which is circular because the same sentence already says "as probabilidades de cada estado clássico" — the intuition-building synonym is lost ("verossimilhança"/"chance" would keep it). (3) "Como matrizes de densidade, estados puros sempre têm um autovalor igual a 1" is ambiguous between "As density matrices…" and "Like density matrices…", the latter falsely implying pure states are something other than density matrices; "Enquanto matrizes de densidade" removes the ambiguity. (4) The example list still carries the English `\text{and}` where the corpus overwhelmingly uses `\text{e}` (40 vs 5), so an English word renders on a Portuguese page. Register is fine: impersonal/informal throughout (Suponha, Note, Lembre-se), no o senhor/vossa.

examples.source: here's a state from the *Single systems* lesson of the "Basics of quantum information" course
examples.suggested: aqui está um estado da aula *Sistemas únicos* do curso "Fundamentos da informação quântica"
examples.translation: aqui está um estado da aula *Sistemas simples* do curso "Fundamentos da informação quântica"
examples.why: "Single" rendered as the false friend "simples" (= simple). The pt corpus already links that lesson as "Sistemas únicos" (i18n/pt/.../entanglement-in-action/qiskit-implementation.mdx, lines 434 and 460), so the cross-reference names a lesson the learner cannot find.

examples.source: give us the probabilities for each classical state to appear ... so we can think about these entries as describing the "weight" or "likelihood" associated with each classical state
examples.suggested: ... como descrevendo o "peso" ou a "verossimilhança" associada a cada estado clássico
examples.translation: nos fornecem as probabilidades de cada estado clássico aparecer ... podemos pensar nessas entradas como descrevendo o "peso" ou "probabilidade" associado a cada estado clássico
examples.why: English uses an informal synonym distinct from the technical "probabilities" it just used; collapsing both onto "probabilidade" makes the gloss tautological and removes the intuition the sentence exists to build.

examples.source: As density matrices, pure states always have one eigenvalue equal to 1 and all other eigenvalues equal to 0.
examples.suggested: Enquanto matrizes de densidade, os estados puros sempre têm um autovalor igual a $1$ e todos os outros iguais a $0.$
examples.translation: Como matrizes de densidade, estados puros sempre têm um autovalor igual a $1$ e todos os outros autovalores iguais a $0.$
examples.why: "Como" here reads equally as "Like density matrices", which would wrongly suggest pure states are a separate class being compared to density matrices rather than a special case of them; "Enquanto" carries the English "As" unambiguously.

examples.source: \quad\text{and}\quad
examples.suggested: \quad\text{e}\quad
examples.translation: \quad\text{and}\quad
examples.why: Untranslated English connector that renders as visible text in the list of example density matrices; the pt corpus uses \text{e} 40 times against 5 leftover \text{and}.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no hallucination, no dropped caveat: the QPU/ISA transformation sentence, the `mode` parameter mapping ("objetos `batch`, `session` ou `backend` ... respectivamente"), the Open Plan restriction ("usuários do Plano Aberto não podem enviar jobs de Session") and the experimental-feature warning on fractional gates all match the English exactly, and core terms are correct and consistent (expectation values → "valores esperados", observable → "observável", PUB → "bloco unificado primitivo", ansatz/transpile handled correctly). The only things a native technical editor would touch are two bits of translationese in the "Próximos passos" list: "Pratique com primitivas trabalhando na lição de função de custo" is a literal calque of "by working through the lesson" (PT would say "fazendo a lição sobre funções de custo"), and "Revise exemplos detalhados" for "Review detailed examples" reads as the English verb rather than the natural "Consulte exemplos detalhados". Neither misleads a learner; register is consistently informal "você" with no formal slips.

examples.source: Practice with primitives by working through the [Cost function lesson] in IBM Quantum Learning.
examples.suggested: Pratique com as primitivas fazendo a [lição sobre funções de custo] no IBM Quantum Learning.
examples.translation: Pratique com primitivas trabalhando na [lição de função de custo] no IBM Quantum Learning.
examples.why: "trabalhando na lição" is a word-for-word calque of "working through the lesson"; in Portuguese "trabalhar em" a lesson suggests authoring/editing it rather than studying it, and the bare "lição de função de custo" reads stiffly next to the natural "lição sobre funções de custo".

examples.source: Review detailed [examples].
examples.suggested: Consulte [exemplos] detalhados.
examples.translation: Revise [exemplos] detalhados.
examples.why: "Revise" mirrors the English verb but in PT it primarily means to proofread/revise something you own; for pointing a reader at reference material a native technical writer writes "Consulte" or "Veja". Meaning is still recoverable, so this is cosmetic.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination anywhere: the load-bearing technical paragraphs are faithful, including the heavy-hex explanation ("o circuito original requer conectividade em formato de estrela (um nó de grau 4) ... cujos nós têm grau no máximo 3") and the tricky negation in "Nem todo estágio individual pode sempre ser executado de forma independente", which correctly renders the awkward English "Any individual stage cannot always be run independently". Terminology is correct and consistent (portas, passes do transpilador, estágio, transpilador do Qiskit, circuito mais raso, "a menos de Cliffords locais"), and the "você" register holds. What a native editor would still change: the §3.4 calque "Depois de embutirmos o circuito para o alvo" (embed/target rendered word-for-word, reads as MT next to the otherwise fluent prose); the pluralized code token "Há 4 `optimization_level`s disponíveis" (identifiers don't take a Portuguese plural -s; also the numeral where the English spells out "four"); and the clipped exercise instruction "Tente modificando o código acima." None of these mislead.

examples.source: After we've embedded the circuit for the target the circuit has expanded quite a bit.
examples.suggested: Depois de adaptarmos o circuito ao dispositivo alvo, ele cresceu bastante.
examples.translation: Depois de embutirmos o circuito para o alvo, o circuito cresceu bastante.
examples.why: "embutir ... para o alvo" is a word-for-word calque of embed/target; no Portuguese quantum engineer would describe transpiling onto a device this way, and the repeated "o circuito ... o circuito" is stiff. Meaning survives, so this is style, not drift.

examples.source: `optimization_level` has four options, from 0 to 3.
examples.suggested: O parâmetro `optimization_level` tem quatro opções, de 0 a 3.
examples.translation: Há 4 `optimization_level`s disponíveis, de 0 a 3.
examples.why: A code identifier is given a Portuguese plural ending (`optimization_level`s), which reads as a typo inside inline code; the English also spells out "four" rather than using a digit.

examples.source: Try it by modifying the code above.
examples.suggested: Faça isso modificando o código acima.
examples.translation: Tente modificando o código acima.
examples.why: "Tente modificando" is clipped — the object of "Tente" is missing in Portuguese, so the imperative dangles. Reads as translationese in otherwise natural instructional prose.

examples.source: Note that some code snippets might become deprecated since these are static images.
examples.suggested: Observe que alguns trechos de código podem ficar desatualizados com o tempo, pois são imagens estáticas.
examples.translation: Observe que alguns trechos de código podem ter sido descontinuados, pois são imagens estáticas.
examples.why: Future possibility ("might become") shifted to past ("podem ter sido"). Harmless for the reader — the practical warning is identical — so this is a MINOR tense slip, not a misleading claim.

editor_note: No semantic drift, no hallucination: the load-bearing region paragraph is rendered exactly ("Você pode acessar qualquer região usando a mesma chave de API, mas só pode ver e acessar as instâncias criadas na região em que você está conectado"), and the trusted/untrusted-environment split, the `save_account()` recommendation and the CRN/API-token paragraph all match the English. Two editorial slips only. (1) The opening redirect drops the contrastive "instead" — EN "follow the steps in ... invited users **instead**" becomes plain "siga as etapas em ...", losing the signal that the reader should leave this page rather than do both; the instruction still points to the right guide, so it does not mislead, but an editor would restore "em vez disso". (2) "se quiser conectar usando a REST API" uses `conectar` without its reflexive/object, which reads as a calque of English intransitive "to connect"; native usage is "se quiser se conectar" / "conectar-se". Informal "você" register holds throughout, and terminology (jobs, instância, token/chave de API, QPUs, endpoints, cargas de trabalho) is correct and consistent.

examples.source: If you were emailed an invitation to join an account, follow the steps in [Set up your IBM Cloud account - invited users](/guides/cloud-setup-invited) instead.
examples.suggested: Se você recebeu um convite por e-mail para entrar em uma conta, siga as etapas em [Configure sua conta IBM Cloud - usuários convidados](/guides/cloud-setup-invited) em vez destas.
examples.translation: Se você recebeu um convite por e-mail para entrar em uma conta, siga as etapas em [Configure sua conta IBM Cloud - usuários convidados](/guides/cloud-setup-invited).
examples.why: The contrastive 'instead' is dropped. It is the word that tells invited users this page does not apply to them; without it the sentence reads as an additional step rather than a replacement path. Not misleading enough to fail, but a real dropped qualifier.

examples.source: Follow [these instructions](/guides/cloud-setup-rest-api) if you want to connect by using the REST API instead of using Qiskit.
examples.suggested: Siga [estas instruções](/guides/cloud-setup-rest-api) se quiser se conectar usando a REST API em vez do Qiskit.
examples.translation: Siga [estas instruções](/guides/cloud-setup-rest-api) se quiser conectar usando a REST API em vez do Qiskit.
examples.why: 'conectar' is used intransitively, mirroring English syntax; in Portuguese the verb needs its reflexive ('se conectar' / 'conectar-se') or an object. A calque a native technical writer would not produce.

examples.source: Make sure that the correct account and region are selected in the account switcher in the header
examples.suggested: Certifique-se de que a conta e a região corretas estejam selecionadas no seletor de contas no cabeçalho
examples.translation: Certifique-se de que a conta e a região corretas estão selecionadas no seletor de contas no cabeçalho
examples.why: Indicative 'estão' after 'certifique-se de que' is widely accepted in Brazilian usage, so this is a defensible choice rather than an error — listed only for completeness; it is not counted among the two issues.

editor_note: Semantically faithful throughout — I found no drift, no dropped caveat and no hallucination: the promise, the two cases (injetora vs dois-para-um), the $2^{n-1}$ counts, the $1 - 2^{-r}$ bound, the $2^{n/2-1}-1$ classical lower bound and the "enquanto não consultarmos a função em duas strings que têm o mesmo valor de saída" intuition all match the English exactly, and math terms are right ("range" → *imagem*, "preimage" → *pré-imagem*, "null space" → *espaço nulo*, "Gaussian elimination" → *eliminação gaussiana*). What a native technical editor would change is a layer of calqued syntax: "vantagem *exponencial* do quantum sobre os algoritmos clássicos" (l. 15, repeated l. 306) leaves the English noun *quantum* standing where Portuguese wants "dos algoritmos quânticos sobre os clássicos" — and the sibling file measuring-computational-cost.mdx already uses the better "do quântico sobre o clássico"; "simplificar a declaração ... para que ela leia" (l. 42) is a word-for-word "so that it reads"; "colocando essas strings em baldes separados" (l. 143) is a literal "buckets"; "esse problema não tem intenção de ter importância prática" (l. 36) calques "isn't intended to have". Also a small internal inconsistency: "all-zero" is rendered as natural "string de zeros" (ll. 39, 41, 45) but as calqued "estado todo-zero" / "vetor todo-zero" (ll. 91, 261, 280). None of this misleads a learner.

examples.source: it provides an *exponential* advantage of quantum over classical (including probabilistic) algorithms
examples.suggested: oferece uma vantagem *exponencial* dos algoritmos quânticos sobre os clássicos (incluindo os probabilísticos)
examples.translation: oferece uma vantagem *exponencial* do quantum sobre os algoritmos clássicos (incluindo probabilísticos)
examples.why: "do quantum" leaves the English noun untranslated in a Portuguese prepositional phrase; the ellipsis "quantum ... algorithms" that works in English does not survive the calque. The neighbouring lesson measuring-computational-cost.mdx already writes "vantagem *quadrática* do quântico sobre o clássico", so this file is also out of step with the course.

examples.source: we can simplify the if and only if statement in the promise so that it reads $[f(x) = f(y)] \Leftrightarrow [x = y].$
examples.suggested: podemos simplificar a afirmação de "se e somente se" na promessa, de modo que ela fique $[f(x) = f(y)] \Leftrightarrow [x = y].$
examples.translation: podemos simplificar a declaração de "se e somente se" na promessa para que ela leia $[f(x) = f(y)] \Leftrightarrow [x = y].$
examples.why: "para que ela leia" is a literal rendering of "so that it reads"; in Portuguese *ler* here makes the statement the reader rather than the thing read. A native technical writer would use "de modo que fique" / "passe a ser". Meaning is still recoverable, so this is minor.

examples.source: we're basically just putting these strings into separate buckets depending on which output string $z = f(x)$ they produce
examples.suggested: basicamente estamos separando essas strings em grupos, conforme a string de saída $z = f(x)$ que elas produzem
examples.translation: basicamente estamos colocando essas strings em baldes separados dependendo de qual string de saída $z = f(x)$ elas produzem
examples.why: "baldes" is a direct calque of the English pedagogical metaphor "buckets"; outside hash-table jargon it reads as translationese in Portuguese prose. The classification image survives, so the pedagogy is not damaged — just stiff.

examples.source: the all-zero string $0^n$ … the all-zero state … the all-zero vector
examples.suggested: pick one convention, e.g. "string de zeros" / "estado de zeros" / "vetor de zeros" (or "vetor nulo" for the vector)
examples.translation: a string de zeros $0^n$ … o estado todo-zero … o vetor todo-zero
examples.why: The same English modifier "all-zero" is rendered idiomatically in one place and as the hyphenated calque "todo-zero" in others within the same file. The concept stays identifiable, so this is a consistency slip, not a comprehension problem.

examples.source: *Gaussian elimination*, which works the same way when arithmetic is done modulo $2$ as it does with real or complex numbers
examples.suggested: *eliminação gaussiana*, que funciona da mesma forma com aritmética módulo $2$ e com números reais ou complexos
examples.translation: *eliminação gaussiana*, que funciona da mesma forma quando a aritmética é feita módulo $2$ como funciona com números reais ou complexos
examples.why: The English "the same way … as it does …" correlative is transposed literally; Portuguese needs "assim como" or a coordinated "e", not "da mesma forma … como funciona". Grammatical but audibly translated.

editor_note: Meaning is fully faithful — the load-bearing caveat in "Adicionar e atualizar tags" survives intact ("Esse método sobrescreve as tags atuais, portanto, se você já atribuiu tags a um job e deseja adicionar tags adicionais, certifique-se de reatribuir as tags originais"), register is consistently informal "você", and job/tag/backend/Sampler are kept in English consistently. The only editorial defect is stylistic: the intro sentence stacks "foca em como adicionar e atualizar tags de job, bem como em como pesquisar por tags de job", where the doubled "em como" plus the verbatim repetition of "tags de job" reads as calqued from the English structure; a native writer would collapse it to "bem como pesquisar por elas". Nothing here would mislead a learner — no inverted condition, swapped quantity, or dropped qualifier anywhere in the file.

examples.source: This guide focuses on how to add and update job tags, as well as how to search by job tags, so that you can better organize, track, and understand your experiments.
examples.suggested: Este guia mostra como adicionar e atualizar tags de job, bem como pesquisar por elas, para que você possa organizar, rastrear e compreender melhor seus experimentos.
examples.translation: Este guia foca em como adicionar e atualizar tags de job, bem como em como pesquisar por tags de job, para que você possa organizar, rastrear e compreender melhor seus experimentos.
examples.why: The English "as well as how to" is carried over word-for-word, producing "bem como em como" — a doubled preposition+interrogative a Portuguese technical writer would never string together — and the full noun phrase "tags de job" is repeated within the same clause where a pronoun is idiomatic. Meaning is unaffected; it simply reads as translated rather than written.

editor_note: No misleading content: the goal ("a fidelidade do seu estado GHZ seja > 0,5"), the fidelity/depth commentary, the "de 5 para 6 / de 9 para 8" surprise remark, and the "não atende aos critérios" verdicts all track the English exactly, and the informal "você" register holds throughout. What a native editor would still change: "utility-scale" is rendered two ways — "Experimento em escala de utilidade III" in the H1 vs "computação quântica em escala utilitária" in the closing congratulation ("utilitária" also reads as "utilitarian" rather than "utility-scale"); "gate" is split between "portas de dois qubits"/"erros de porta 2q" (§2) and "erros de gate" (§3) in the same explanatory role; the §1.1 motivating sentence softens "at least more than 50% likely" to "probabilidade de pelo menos 50%" (≥ instead of >, at exactly the threshold the lesson is about); and the §2 heading "Seleção de qubits com consciência de ruído" is a stiff calque of "noise-aware". None of these teach a false concept — the goal itself is stated correctly with "> 0,5" and "maior que 0,5" in both §1.2 and §5.

examples.source: Utility-scale experiment III … your introduction to utility-scale quantum computing
examples.suggested: Use one rendering throughout, e.g. "em escala de utilidade" in both places
examples.translation: Experimento em escala de utilidade III … computação quântica em escala utilitária
examples.why: The course's key framing term is split within one file; "escala utilitária" additionally reads as "utilitarian scale" rather than "utility-scale", weakening a term the whole course is named after.

examples.source: the qubits that have the lowest errors when implementing those two-qubit gates … edges with "bad" gate errors
examples.suggested: …as arestas com erros de porta "ruins"
examples.translation: os qubits que apresentam os menores erros ao implementar essas portas de dois qubits … as arestas com erros de gate "ruins"
examples.why: "gate" is translated as "porta" in §2 but left as "gate" in the parallel sentence in §3; same concept, two words, in adjacent explanatory prose.

examples.source: while still getting results where the correct states are at least more than 50% likely
examples.suggested: …mantendo os estados corretos com probabilidade superior a 50%
examples.translation: mantendo os estados corretos com probabilidade de pelo menos 50%
examples.why: "more than 50%" becomes "pelo menos 50%" (≥ instead of >). Not misleading overall — §1.2 and §5 both state the criterion correctly as "> 0,5" — but the qualifier is weakened exactly at the threshold the exercise hinges on.

examples.source: ## 2. Strategy 1. Noise-aware qubit selection
examples.suggested: Seleção de qubits considerando o ruído / com base nos erros de ruído
examples.translation: ## 2. Estratégia 1: Seleção de qubits com consciência de ruído
examples.why: "com consciência de ruído" is a word-for-word calque of "noise-aware"; a Portuguese-speaking quantum engineer would phrase the heading around "considerando o ruído" or "guiada pelo ruído".

editor_note: Nothing here misleads a learner: the technical prose is faithful (print/None side-effect explanation, the TextDrawer/matplotlib.Figure/PIL.Image return-type list, the fold description "no renderizador `text` ... o comprimento das linhas ... ao usar o renderizador `mpl`, esse é o número de camadas (visuais)"), the informal "você" register holds throughout, and "renderizador", "kwarg", "saída" and "barreiras" are used consistently. Four editor-level slips: (1) the opening sentence turns the frequency qualifier "It's often useful" into an intensity claim, "É muito útil" — the correct rendering is "Muitas vezes é útil"; (2) "circuit" is split within the file between the untranslated plural "circuits" and the Portuguese "circuito", sometimes in the same sentence ("o desenho de circuits pelo método `draw()`, ou imprimindo o objeto do circuito"), and the title reads "Visualizar circuits"; (3) "mas não oferece a maior flexibilidade" is a word-for-word calque of "doesn't provide the most flexibility" that a native technical writer would phrase as "mas não é a opção mais flexível"; (4) "for brevity" becomes "por simplicidade" (simplicity) rather than "por brevidade/concisão". None of these change what the page teaches.

examples.source: It's often useful to see the circuits you're creating.
examples.suggested: Muitas vezes é útil visualizar os circuitos que você está criando.
examples.translation: É muito útil visualizar os circuits que você está criando.
examples.why: "often" is a frequency qualifier; "muito" converts it into an intensity claim ("very useful"). Harmless here, but it is not what the source says.

examples.source: circuit / circuits
examples.suggested: Use "circuito(s)" consistently in prose; keep English only for the class name `QuantumCircuit`.
examples.translation: "circuits" (title, line 32, line 45, line 233) vs "circuito" / "circuito quântico" (lines 43, 45, 114, 141, 248)
examples.why: Same concept rendered two ways inside one sentence ("o desenho de circuits pelo método `draw()`, ou imprimindo o objeto do circuito"); the concept stays identifiable, so this is a consistency slip, not a comprehension problem.

examples.source: A text output is useful for quickly seeing the output while developing a circuit, but it doesn't provide the most flexibility.
examples.suggested: ...mas não é a opção mais flexível.
examples.translation: ...mas não oferece a maior flexibilidade.
examples.why: Literal calque of the English superlative; "não oferece a maior flexibilidade" is stiff and reads as translated rather than written.

examples.source: The following examples work with any output renderer; `mpl` is used here for brevity.
examples.suggested: ...; `mpl` é usado aqui por brevidade.
examples.translation: Os exemplos a seguir funcionam com qualquer renderizador; `mpl` é usado aqui por simplicidade.
examples.why: "for brevity" is about keeping the example short, not about it being simpler; "por simplicidade" shifts the stated reason slightly.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, swapped quantities or hallucinated claims; the whole Pauli-decomposition / syndrome-collapse argument, the "estado produto" passage and the "pelo design do código, uma operação de qubit único não pode alterar o estado do qubit lógico" caveat all land correctly. What a native editor would still fix: the closing sentence of the lesson misattaches its relative clause ("removendo assim do sistema a aleatoriedade gerada neste processo que armazena a codificação") so it reads as if the *process*, not the system, stores the encoding — the meaning is recoverable but the sentence is garbled at exactly the pedagogical punchline. "reset" is rendered two ways within the file ("um canal de reset" kept in English vs. qubits "redefinidos"/"redefini-los"), and "redefinir" is the wrong verb for qubit reset in Portuguese (reinicializar/resetar is the domain convention). Minor also: "canal de dephasing ou depolarizing" leaves lowercase English where Portuguese has settled terms (canal de defasagem / despolarizante), and "projetamos o erro para um erro" should be "projetamos ... sobre/em".

examples.source: Meanwhile, whatever randomness is generated in the process is moved into the syndrome qubits, which are discarded or reset, thereby removing the randomness generated in this process from the system that stores the encoding.
examples.suggested: Enquanto isso, qualquer aleatoriedade gerada no processo é movida para os qubits de síndrome, que são descartados ou reinicializados, removendo assim a aleatoriedade gerada neste processo do sistema que armazena a codificação.
examples.translation: Enquanto isso, qualquer aleatoriedade gerada no processo é movida para os qubits de síndrome, que são descartados ou redefinidos, removendo assim do sistema a aleatoriedade gerada neste processo que armazena a codificação.
examples.why: The relative clause 'que armazena a codificação' ends up attached to 'processo' instead of 'sistema' because 'do sistema' was fronted. The concluding takeaway of the lesson reads as nonsense on first parse ('the process that stores the encoding').

examples.source: a reset channel / discarded or reset / discarded or reset
examples.suggested: um canal de reset (ou 'de reinicialização') / ... ou reinicializá-los / ... ou reinicializados
examples.translation: um canal de reset / descartar os qubits de síndrome ou redefini-los / descartados ou redefinidos
examples.why: The same operation is rendered as English 'reset' in one place and as 'redefinir' in two others. 'Redefinir' means 'redefine' and is not the Portuguese term for resetting a qubit; the standard rendering is reinicializar (or the borrowed 'resetar').

examples.source: this could be a dephasing or depolarizing channel
examples.suggested: este poderia ser um canal de defasagem ou despolarizante
examples.translation: este poderia ser um canal de dephasing ou depolarizing
examples.why: Unlike bit-flip/phase-flip, these two have long-established Portuguese renderings (defasagem, despolarizante/despolarizador) used in the QEC literature; leaving the bare English participles reads as untranslated filler in otherwise fully translated prose.

examples.source: we effectively *project* the error onto an error that's described by a Pauli matrix
examples.suggested: efetivamente *projetamos* o erro sobre um erro descrito por uma matriz de Pauli
examples.translation: efetivamente *projetamos* o erro para um erro descrito por uma matriz de Pauli
examples.why: 'Projetar para' is a calque of 'project onto'; Portuguese takes 'projetar sobre/em'. Meaning survives, but the preposition marks the sentence as translated rather than written.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, swapped quantities or dropped caveats; the fractional-gates experimental caveat, the "as long as the parameter values are also provided" condition and the Open Plan session-job restriction all survive intact, and core terms are correct and consistent (expectation value → "valoare de așteptare", observable → "observabil/observabili", transpiler kept, backend/QPU/gate kept). Four editorial slips: "opțiunile primitive" in Next steps renders "the primitive options" as "rudimentary options" instead of "opțiunile primitivei"; "Rețineți că utilizatorii planului Open..." is formal-plural (dvs.) in a file that is otherwise consistently informal tu ("îți permite", "invocă", "Ai nevoie"); "folosești parametrul `mode`" turns the English imperative "use the `mode` parameter" into a flat indicative; and there is light translationese in "Pașii din acest subiect" (calque of "this topic"), "față de stările pregătite" (for "with respect to"; RO physics idiom is "în raport cu") and "circuite de arhitectură set de instrucțiuni" (missing genitive — "arhitectura setului de instrucțiuni"). None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: Learn how to [use the primitive options](runtime-options-overview).
examples.suggested: Află cum să [utilizezi opțiunile primitivei](runtime-options-overview).
examples.translation: Află cum să [utilizezi opțiunile primitive](runtime-options-overview).
examples.why: In English "primitive" is the noun being modified-from ("options of the primitive"). In Romanian the post-posed adjective "primitive" reads as "rudimentary/basic options", which is not what the link points to. Needs the genitive "primitivei".

examples.source: Note that Open Plan users cannot submit session jobs.
examples.suggested: Reține că utilizatorii planului Open nu pot trimite joburi de sesiune.
examples.translation: Rețineți că utilizatorii planului Open nu pot trimite joburi de sesiune.
examples.why: "Rețineți" is the formal/plural (dumneavoastră) imperative. The rest of the file is consistently informal tu — "îți permite", "să configurezi", "invocă", "Ai nevoie", "Urmează pașii" — so this is an isolated register break.

examples.source: When you initialize Estimator, use the `mode` parameter to specify the mode you want it to run in.
examples.suggested: Când inițializezi Estimator, folosește parametrul `mode` pentru a specifica modul în care vrei să ruleze.
examples.translation: Când inițializezi Estimator, folosești parametrul `mode` pentru a specifica modul în care vrei să ruleze.
examples.why: The English is an instruction (imperative "use"); the indicative "folosești" turns it into a description of what happens, weakening the step-by-step teaching voice used elsewhere in the same numbered list ("invocă metoda run()", "Folosește transpilerul").

examples.source: expectation values ... with respect to states prepared by quantum circuits / The steps in this topic describe / instruction set architecture (ISA) circuits
examples.suggested: ... în raport cu stările pregătite de circuite cuantice / Pașii din această pagină descriu / circuite cu *arhitectura setului de instrucțiuni (ISA)*
examples.translation: valorile de așteptare ... față de stările pregătite de circuite cuantice / Pașii din acest subiect descriu / circuite de *arhitectură set de instrucțiuni (ISA)*
examples.why: Three calques a Romanian technical writer would not produce: "în raport cu" is the standard physics rendering of "with respect to"; "acest subiect" is a literal transfer of the docs word "topic" (RO uses "această pagină"/"acest ghid"); and "arhitectură set de instrucțiuni" stacks two nouns without the genitive Romanian requires.

editor_note: One outright logical inversion drives the FAIL: in "Corectarea erorilor" the English "unless $n=r$ (in which case we have a trivial, one-dimensional code space), we can't possibly correct every error" becomes "dacă $n=r$ ... nu putem corecta fiecare eroare detectată" — "unless" was rendered as "dacă", so the translation teaches the exact opposite (that the trivial n=r case is the one where correction fails, rather than the sole exception where it succeeds). Second, the lesson's closing sentence "We'll see this artistry on display in the next lesson." is missing entirely — the file ends at "...arta designului codurilor cuantice.", dropping the forward pointer to the next lesson. Terminology also splits mid-file: the first half consistently uses "generatori stabilizatori" / "mulțime generatoare minimală" / "spațiul de cod", while from the 9-qubit Shor section onward it switches to "generatori Stabilizer" / "set minimal de generatori" / "spațiul codului" (concept still identifiable, so MINOR on its own). Minor stiffness remains at "orice acțiune netrivială ar putea avea $E$ are loc în afara spațiului codului" (garbled word order for "whatever nontrivial action E may have") and "operații care se egalizează pentru eroarea de cea mai mică greutate" (calque of "tie for the lowest weight").

examples.source: This means that, unless $n=r$ (in which case we have a trivial, one-dimensional code space), we can't possibly correct every error detected by a stabilizer code.
examples.suggested: Asta înseamnă că, cu excepția cazului în care $n=r$ (caz în care avem un spațiu de cod trivial, unidimensional), nu putem corecta orice eroare detectată de un cod stabilizator.
examples.translation: Asta înseamnă că, dacă $n=r$ (caz în care avem un spațiu de cod trivial, unidimensional), nu putem corecta fiecare eroare detectată de un cod Stabilizer.
examples.why: 'unless' → 'dacă' inverts the condition. The English says correction of every error is impossible EXCEPT when n=r; the Romanian says it is impossible WHEN n=r, implying the opposite in every other case. A learner would form a false belief about when a stabilizer code can correct all detected errors.

examples.source: We'll see this artistry on display in the next lesson.
examples.suggested: Vom vedea această artă la lucru în lecția următoare.
examples.translation: (sentence absent — file ends at "...face parte din arta designului codurilor cuantice.")
examples.why: The closing sentence of the lesson is dropped, removing the explicit pointer forward to the next lesson (a pedagogical signpost the course relies on).

examples.source: stabilizer generators / stabilizer code
examples.suggested: Use 'generatori stabilizatori' / 'cod stabilizator' consistently throughout.
examples.translation: 'generatori stabilizatori', 'cod stabilizator' (first half) vs 'generatori Stabilizer', 'cod Stabilizer' (from the 9-qubit Shor section to the end)
examples.why: The file changes its core term mid-document, and also switches 'mulțime generatoare minimală' → 'set minimal de generatori' and 'spațiul de cod' → 'spațiul codului'. The concept stays identifiable, so this is MINOR, but a native technical editor would unify it.

examples.source: whatever nontrivial action $E$ may have happens outside of the code space
examples.suggested: orice acțiune netrivială pe care ar putea-o avea $E$ are loc în afara spațiului codului
examples.translation: orice acțiune netrivială ar putea avea $E$ are loc în afara spațiului codului
examples.why: Word-for-word calque of the English relative clause; the missing 'pe care ... o' makes the Romanian sentence ungrammatical and forces the reader to re-parse.

examples.source: There may in fact be multiple operations that tie for the lowest weight error consistent with a given syndrome
examples.suggested: Se poate ca mai multe operații să aibă aceeași greutate minimă, compatibilă cu un sindrom dat
examples.translation: Pot exista de fapt mai multe operații care se egalizează pentru eroarea de cea mai mică greutate consistentă cu un sindrom dat
examples.why: 'care se egalizează pentru' is a literal rendering of English 'tie for' that no Romanian technical writer would use; the intended meaning (equal minimal weight) is only recoverable with effort.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the delicate physics passages survive intact (ZZ parity phase on |01⟩/|10⟩ "și lasă stările cu paritate pară neschimbate", the measure-0 / measure-1 → ZZ(θ+π) branch, the "adâncime de măsurare 1" commuting-ZZ argument, and the closing trade-off "cu prețul introducerii unor Qubiți ancila suplimentari"), so nothing here would mislead a learner. What a native technical editor would change is consistency and register: "magnetization" is rendered "magnetizarea medie" early (Pentru a sonda dinamica spinilor…) but "magnetizația medie" / "magnetizația de spin" in Step 4; "honeycomb lattice" stays "rețeaua honeycomb" for the whole tutorial and then becomes "rețea în fagure" only in the concluding paragraph; and "two-qubit depth" appears as "adâncime de doi qubiți", "adâncime pe doi qubiți", "adâncimii Gate-urilor cu doi qubiți" and "adâncime de porți cu doi Qubiți". The informal-"tu" convention holds in most instructions ("asigură-te că ai instalate", "Poți folosi", "consultă această pagină") but breaks into formal plural in three places ("Rețineți că rețeaua honeycomb…", "consultați documentația OpenQASM", "Rețineți că `measure_2` nu este suportată"). Two small wording slips: "este dată de următorul unitar" uses the English noun-as-noun (Romanian wants "operator unitar"), and the final `<TutorialFeedback />` render is missing although the import is kept (structural, not prose).

examples.source: Note that the honeycomb lattice we want to simulate does not match the heavy lattice… / please refer to the OpenQASM documentation
examples.suggested: Reține că rețeaua honeycomb… / consultă documentația OpenQASM
examples.translation: Rețineți că rețeaua honeycomb pe care dorim să o simulăm… / consultați documentația [OpenQASM]
examples.why: The file otherwise uses informal 'tu' ('asigură-te că ai instalate', 'Poți folosi', 'consultă această pagină', 'Dacă primești erori'); these three switch to formal plural imperatives, breaking the register convention.

examples.source: we study the average magnetization of the spins … / compute the average magnetization estimated by the observables
examples.suggested: Pick one — 'magnetizația medie' throughout (matches the plot label 'Average magnetization').
examples.translation: studiem magnetizarea medie a spinilor … / calculăm magnetizația medie estimată de observabile
examples.why: The central measured quantity of the whole tutorial is named two different ways in the same file; recognizable, but a reader tracking one term across the four steps has to re-map it.

examples.source: honeycomb lattice / simulating Ising spin models on a honeycomb lattice
examples.suggested: Keep 'rețea honeycomb' in the conclusion too (or introduce 'în fagure' once at first mention and use it consistently).
examples.translation: rețeaua honeycomb (throughout) … apoi „simularea modelelor de spin Ising pe o rețea în fagure"
examples.why: The summary paragraph renames the lattice the entire tutorial has been calling 'honeycomb', so the concluding sentence reads as if it might be about a different topology.

examples.source: two-qubit depth / two-qubit gate depth
examples.suggested: Standardize on 'adâncimea porților cu doi qubiți' (or 'adâncimea pe doi qubiți') in all four places.
examples.translation: „adâncime de doi qubiți" / „adâncimii Gate-urilor cu doi qubiți" / „adâncime pe doi qubiți" / „adâncime de porți cu doi Qubiți"
examples.why: Four renderings of the single metric that the whole unitary-vs-dynamic comparison turns on; the meaning survives but the plot, the heading and the conclusion no longer visibly refer to the same quantity.

examples.source: is given by the following unitary:
examples.suggested: este dat de următorul operator unitar:
examples.translation: este dată de următorul unitar:
examples.why: 'unitar' is an adjective in Romanian; used bare as a noun it is a calque of English 'the unitary' and a Romanian physicist would write 'operatorul unitar' (which also fixes the gender agreement of 'dată').

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every prose paragraph tracks the English faithfully (the AQC target/ansatz/remainder explanation at "Optimizarea AQC-Tensor are loc în pasul 1", the dry-run caveat, and the closing "Blochează restul programului până când un rezultat este disponibil" all match), and the informal "tu" register holds throughout (descarci, poți, consultă, verifică). What a native editor would fix is terminology consistency and a few calques: "addon" is rendered two ways in the same file — "addon-ul Qiskit"/"addon-ului Qiskit AQC-Tensor" (intro, "Scrie șablonul", "Pași următori") vs "componenta suplimentară AQC" (steps 1 and 2); "two-qubit depth" is "adâncimea pe doi qubiți" in two places but left as "adâncimea two-qubit" in the dry-run section; and "deploy" is "Deployează funcția pe IBM Quantum Platform" in the heading while the frontmatter description says "să îl implementezi". Two calques also read as MT rather than native: the broken noun order "folosind [AQC-Tensor](...) addon-ul Qiskit" (the link is spliced ahead of its head noun), and "reprezentare de tip produs matricial al stărilor", which misparses "matrix-product state" as "matrix product of states" instead of the standard "stare de tip produs matricial (MPS)". None of these would make a learner form a false belief.

examples.source: ...returns a set of specified expectation values using the [AQC-Tensor](https://qiskit.github.io/qiskit-addon-aqc-tensor/) Qiskit addon.
examples.suggested: ...folosind addon-ul Qiskit [AQC-Tensor](https://qiskit.github.io/qiskit-addon-aqc-tensor/).
examples.translation: ...returnează un set de valori de așteptare specificate, folosind [AQC-Tensor](https://qiskit.github.io/qiskit-addon-aqc-tensor/) addon-ul Qiskit.
examples.why: The link text is spliced in front of its head noun, producing a word order no Romanian writer would use — the determined noun 'addon-ul Qiskit' must precede the proper name, not follow it.

examples.source: AQC addon / AQC-Tensor Qiskit addon
examples.suggested: Use "addon-ul AQC" / "addon-ul Qiskit" consistently throughout.
examples.translation: "componenta suplimentară AQC" (steps 1 and 2) vs "addon-ul Qiskit" / "addon-ului Qiskit AQC-Tensor" (intro, Scrie șablonul, Pași următori)
examples.why: The same product concept (the Qiskit addon) is split between an English-kept term and a descriptive paraphrase within one page, so the reader cannot tell they refer to the same component.

examples.source: a matrix product state representation of this circuit is found using the AQC addon
examples.suggested: se găsește o reprezentare de tip stare produs matricial (MPS) a acestui circuit folosind addon-ul AQC
examples.translation: se găsește o reprezentare de tip produs matricial al stărilor pentru acest circuit folosind componenta suplimentară AQC
examples.why: "produs matricial al stărilor" parses the English as 'matrix product OF states'; the object is a state that has a matrix-product form (MPS), which is the term used consistently later in the logs ('Target MPS maximum bond dimension').

examples.source: you want first to inspect the two-qubit depth of the ISA circuit
examples.suggested: vrei să inspectezi mai întâi adâncimea pe doi qubiți a circuitului ISA
examples.translation: vrei să inspectezi mai întâi adâncimea two-qubit a circuitului ISA
examples.why: The same metric is translated as "adâncimea pe doi qubiți" in the logging paragraph and in the job-logs paragraph, but left as raw English "adâncimea two-qubit" here — inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: Deploy the function to IBM Quantum Platform / deploy it to IBM Quantum Platform
examples.suggested: Use "Implementează funcția pe IBM Quantum Platform" in the heading to match the description.
examples.translation: Heading: "Deployează funcția pe IBM Quantum Platform"; frontmatter description: "să îl implementezi pe IBM Quantum Platform"
examples.why: "Deployează" is a raw anglicism that clashes with the verb the same page already chose in its description; a Romanian technical editor would pick one and keep it.

editor_note: Three chunks of source prose are simply missing, two of them in the final 40%. The closing paragraph stops after "...sunt la fel de probabile." and drops the entire last sentence of the article — "Increasing $L$ doesn't have a significant effect on the break-even point at which the code starts to help, but does lead to a faster decrease in the probability for a logical error..." — so the Romanian learner never sees the caveat that growing $L$ does NOT move the threshold, only the sub-threshold suppression rate; that is exactly the misconception the English sentence exists to preempt. In the loop-classification section the disambiguating gloss ("Here, a 'horizontal/vertical lattice line' means a full row/column of qubits in the periodic lattice (not the line segments of the loop...)") and the justification in category 1 ("since each lattice line crosses the closed loop of errors once... and once crossing back out") are both gone, leaving "(Exemplul arătat mai sus se încadrează în această categorie.)" as a bare assertion with no reasoning. Secondary: "weight" is rendered "pondere" for stabilizer weight but "greutate" in "potrivire perfectă de greutate minimă" (standard Romanian graph-theory term is "cuplaj perfect de pondere minimă"), and there are small stiffness/register slips ("va corecta corect eroarea", indicative "Observi că..." where the rest of the file uses the imperative "Observă că...").

examples.line_approx: EN 203 / RO end of file (after line 203)
examples.source: Increasing $L$ doesn't have a significant effect on the break-even point at which the code starts to help, but does lead to a faster decrease in the probability for a logical error as the error rate decreases past the break-even point.
examples.suggested: Creșterea lui $L$ nu are un efect semnificativ asupra pragului de rentabilitate de la care codul începe să ajute, dar duce la o scădere mai rapidă a probabilității unei erori logice pe măsură ce rata de eroare scade sub acest prag.
examples.translation: (sentence entirely absent — the Romanian file ends at "...unde $X,$ $Y,$ și $Z,$ sunt la fel de probabile.")
examples.why: The concluding, load-bearing takeaway of the whole page is missing. Without it the learner is left to assume that increasing the lattice size $L$ improves the ~10% threshold itself — the precise false belief the English sentence rules out — and never learns that the benefit of larger $L$ is faster logical-error suppression below threshold.

examples.source: In particular, the different types of loops can be characterized as follows. Here, a 'horizontal/vertical lattice line' means a full row/column of qubits in the periodic lattice (not the line segments of the loop of qubits affected by the X error).
examples.suggested: În particular, diferitele tipuri de bucle pot fi caracterizate după cum urmează. Aici, prin „linie orizontală/verticală a rețelei" înțelegem un rând/o coloană completă de qubiți din rețeaua periodică (nu segmentele de linie ale buclei de qubiți afectați de eroarea X).
examples.translation: În particular, diferitele tipuri de bucle pot fi caracterizate după cum urmează.
examples.why: An explicit disambiguating caveat the English author added to prevent readers from confusing a lattice row/column with the segments of the error loop is dropped. The type-1 vs type-2 loop distinction is the crux of the distance-$L$ argument, so removing the gloss reopens exactly the misreading it was written to close.

examples.source: The example shown above falls into this category, since each lattice line crosses the closed loop of errors once, say crossing into the closed loop, and once crossing back out of the closed loop of errors.
examples.suggested: Exemplul arătat mai sus se încadrează în această categorie, deoarece fiecare linie a rețelei intersectează bucla închisă de erori o dată, să zicem intrând în buclă, și încă o dată ieșind din ea.
examples.translation: (Exemplul arătat mai sus se încadrează în această categorie.)
examples.why: The reason WHY the example has even parity on every lattice line (each line enters and exits the loop) is deleted, so the Romanian gives the classification as an unexplained assertion. The English teaches the intuition; the translation only states the result.

examples.source: a *minimum-weight perfect matching* between the $-1$ measurement outcomes can be computed
examples.suggested: se poate calcula un *cuplaj perfect de pondere minimă* între rezultatele de măsurare $-1$
examples.translation: se poate calcula o *potrivire perfectă de greutate minimă* între rezultatele de măsurare $-1$
examples.why: "Weight" is rendered "pondere" throughout the earlier text ("pondere mică", "operație Pauli de pondere 4") but switches to "greutate" (physical weight) here; and "potrivire" is a calque of "matching" where Romanian graph theory uses "cuplaj". Recognizable but inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: Notice that the lines on the right and on the bottom are dotted lines. / will properly correct the error that caused this syndrome
examples.suggested: Observă că liniile din dreapta și de jos sunt linii punctate. / va corecta în mod corespunzător eroarea care a cauzat acest sindrom
examples.translation: Observi că liniile din dreapta și de jos sunt linii punctate. / va corecta corect eroarea care a cauzat acest sindrom
examples.why: Line 32 uses the indicative "Observi" where the rest of the file uses the imperative "Observă" (lines 50, 64, 126, 139) for the same English "Notice that"; and "va corecta corect" is a clumsy root repetition no native technical writer would leave in.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no hallucination; the delicate passages all survive intact (the appendix condition "dacă complexitatea modelului clasic este de ordinul N, în timp ce complexitatea modelului cuantic-proiectat este substanțial mai mică decât N", the "potențial avantaj" hedges, the 80-minute QPU caveat, and the "ar trebui să fie aproximativ de ordinul √N" threshold). The main editorial defect is a within-file terminology split: "kernel" is rendered as "nucleu/nuclee" for the whole first half (title "nuclee cuantice proiectate", "matrice nucleu", "funcție clasică de nucleu", "nucleu exponențial") and then switches wholesale to the English "kernel" from Step 4 onward ("Kernelul cuantic proiectat", "funcția kernel", "matricei kernel", "acest kernel precalculat", "kernelurile clasic și cuantic") — the concept stays identifiable but a reader meets two names for the same object. Register also wobbles: the file is otherwise consistently informal "tu" ("Poți rula", "asigură-te", "Dacă ai efectuat antrenarea singur") but twice uses the formal plural "Rețineți că…", once in the very sentence that continues "Pentru a te asigura că…". Minor surface slips: the typo "etichentând-o" (should be "etichetând-o") and two calques, "hardware-ul cuantic de termen scurt" / "dispozitivele de termen scurt" (near-term → "pe termen scurt" / "din era actuală") and "CAR-ului inginerat" for "the CAR engineered into T-cells".

examples.source: to construct a kernel matrix … The projected quantum kernel is defined with the following kernel function
examples.suggested: Pick one convention for the whole file — either "nucleu (kernel)" throughout or "kernel" throughout; e.g. "pentru a construi o matrice kernel … Kernelul cuantic proiectat este definit prin următoarea funcție kernel"
examples.translation: pentru a construi o matrice nucleu … Kernelul cuantic proiectat este definit prin următoarea funcție kernel
examples.why: The file's first half consistently calques kernel as "nucleu" (including the page title "nuclee cuantice proiectate") and the second half switches wholesale to "kernel". Not misleading, but the learner meets two names for the same object and the title no longer matches the body.

examples.source: Note that we turn on error mitigation … Note that going over the entire dataset can take about 80 minutes on the QPU. To make sure that the rest of the tutorial is easily executable…
examples.suggested: Reține că activăm atenuarea erorilor … Reține că parcurgerea întregului set de date poate dura aproximativ 80 de minute pe QPU.
examples.translation: Rețineți că activăm atenuarea erorilor … Rețineți că parcurgerea întregului set de date poate dura aproximativ 80 de minute pe QPU. Pentru a te asigura că restul tutorialului este ușor de executat…
examples.why: Formal plural "Rețineți" against the file's otherwise consistent informal "tu" ("Poți rula", "asigură-te", "Dacă ai efectuat") — and the second instance mixes both registers inside two adjacent sentences ("Rețineți… Pentru a te asigura…").

examples.source: particularly for near-term quantum hardware … while remaining more practical for near-term devices
examples.suggested: în special pentru hardware-ul cuantic pe termen scurt (din era actuală) … mai practice pentru dispozitivele actuale / din era NISQ
examples.translation: în special pentru hardware-ul cuantic de termen scurt … rămânând în același timp mai practice pentru dispozitivele de termen scurt
examples.why: "de termen scurt" is a word-for-word calque of "near-term"; Romanian takes "pe termen scurt", and a native technical writer describing NISQ hardware would say "din era actuală" / "dispozitivele actuale". Reads as MT, though the meaning is recoverable.

examples.source: the specific structural or functional component of the CAR engineered into T-cells … labeling it as either toxic or non-toxic
examples.suggested: componenta structurală sau funcțională specifică a CAR-ului introdus prin inginerie genetică în celulele T … etichetând-o fie ca toxică, fie ca non-toxică
examples.translation: componentele structurale sau funcționale specifice ale CAR-ului inginerat în celulele T … etichentând-o fie ca toxică, fie ca non-toxică
examples.why: "inginerat" is a non-word calque of "engineered" (Romanian uses "modificat/proiectat prin inginerie genetică"), and "etichentând-o" is a straight typo for "etichetând-o" in a sentence that states the tutorial's classification task.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: the 1-5 precedence list, the twirling/shots failure caveat, the "Precizia se scalează invers față de utilizare" note and every default/range value match the English exactly, and the informal "tu" holds through most of the body. What a native editor would still change: (1) register slips to formal in the opening body paragraph ("Puteți folosi... Consultați referințele API") and at "Rețineți că opțiunile Estimator...", while the rest of the file uses "Poți / Consultă / Fă clic"; (2) the table label "**Choices**" is rendered "**Opțiuni**", colliding with "opțiuni" = the options themselves under the heading "Opțiuni disponibile" — "Valori posibile" is the right label; (3) three `dynamical_decoupling` sub-items still carry untranslated "Choices:" / "Default:" while all siblings use "Opțiuni:" / "Implicit:"; (4) term slips: "keyword argument" → "argument cheie" (reads as "key/crucial argument"), "ground state" → "starea de bază" (conventional term is "starea fundamentală"; "stare de bază" is what Romanian uses for *basis* state), "to unroll to" → "la care să se desfășoare"; (5) calqued syntax in "None, ceea ce implică fără constrângeri de conectivitate" and "rezultatele nu sunt garantate să atingă precizia specificată". None of these would make a learner form a false belief.

examples.source: You can use options to customize the Estimator primitive. ... Consult the API references for information about ...
examples.suggested: Poți folosi opțiunile pentru a personaliza primitivul Estimator. ... Consultă referințele API ...
examples.translation: Puteți folosi opțiunile pentru a personaliza primitivul Estimator. ... Consultați referințele API pentru informații despre ...
examples.why: The file's convention is informal 'tu' ('Poți vedea', 'Poți seta', 'Consultă ghidul' at max_execution_time, 'Fă clic pe fila'), but the opening body paragraph and the 'Rețineți că opțiunile Estimator...' note switch to formal plural. Same-file register inconsistency.

examples.source: **Choices**: Integer >= 0
examples.suggested: **Valori posibile**: Număr întreg >= 0
examples.translation: **Opțiuni**: Număr întreg >= 0
examples.why: 'Choices' (the permitted values of an option) is rendered with the same word used for 'options' throughout the page, so under the heading 'Opțiuni disponibile' every entry reads 'Opțiuni: ...'. Recognizable, but a label collision a native editor would fix.

examples.source: Choices: `asap`, `alap` / Default: `alap`
examples.suggested: Opțiuni: `asap`, `alap` / Implicit: `alap`
examples.translation: Choices: `asap`, `alap` / Default: `alap`
examples.why: Three dynamical_decoupling sub-items (scheduling_method, sequence_type, skip_reset_qubits) keep the English labels untranslated while every other accordion item in the same table uses the Romanian ones — within-file inconsistency.

examples.source: ... and a precision keyword argument. ... if `precision` is not specified by any PUB or in the run keyword argument
examples.suggested: ... și un argument de tip cuvânt-cheie `precision`. ... sau în argumentul cuvânt-cheie al metodei `run`
examples.translation: ... și un argument cheie precision. ... sau în argumentul cheie run
examples.why: 'argument cheie' reads in Romanian as 'key/crucial argument', not 'keyword argument', so the Python concept is lost; 'argumentul cheie run' also blurs the relation (it is run's keyword argument, not an argument named run).

examples.source: Whether to reset the qubits to the ground state for each shot.
examples.suggested: Dacă qubiții sunt resetați la starea fundamentală înainte de fiecare shot.
examples.translation: Dacă se resetează qubiții la starea de bază pentru fiecare shot.
examples.why: 'ground state' is conventionally 'starea fundamentală' in Romanian physics; 'stare de bază' is the usual rendering of 'basis state', so two distinct concepts are conflated on a page that also discusses basis gates (porți de bază).

examples.source: None, which implies no connectivity constraints (full connectivity). / the results are not guaranteed to reach the specified precision / per circuit per configuration / basis gate names to unroll to
examples.suggested: None, ceea ce înseamnă că nu există constrângeri de conectivitate (conectivitate completă). / nu se garantează că rezultatele vor atinge precizia specificată / pentru fiecare circuit și fiecare configurație / porți de bază în care să fie descompuse porțile circuitului
examples.translation: None, ceea ce implică fără constrângeri de conectivitate (conectivitate completă). / rezultatele nu sunt garantate să atingă precizia specificată / pe circuit pe configurație / nume de porți de bază la care să se desfășoare
examples.why: 'ceea ce implică fără constrângeri' is ungrammatical calqued syntax, 'nu sunt garantate să atingă' copies the English passive, 'pe circuit pe configurație' stacks the English 'per ... per ...', and 'la care să se desfășoare' translates transpiler 'unroll' with a verb meaning 'to unfold/take place'. Stiff, but the meaning is still recoverable.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination found — every derivation, probability, condition and caveat (partial-measurement collapse, the "can't depend on whether Y was also measured / faster-than-light" caveat, the GHZ/W outcome probabilities, the density-matrix remark) matches the English, and the informal "tu" convention holds ("Observă că…"). What a native editor would fix is consistency and two grammar slips. "Entanglement" is rendered three ways in the same file — "întricate/întricată" (l.176, 189, 217), "Întrețeserea (entanglementul)" (l.187–189) and "întrețesere" (l.234); likewise "classical state set" alternates between "mulțimea de stări clasice" and "setul de stări clasice", "joint system" between "sistemul comun" (l.82, 118) and "sistemul compus" (l.849, 899), and "operation" switches wholesale from "operație" to "operațiune" at the swap section (l.929 onward). "qubit" is spelled "qubiți", "qubiti" (l.138, 221, 234, 254) and "qubit-uri" (l.394) in the same document, and "qutrits" appears as "quTriți" (l.301). Two outright grammar errors: "Nu toate vectorii" (l.130, should be "Nu toți vectorii") and "al doi qubiti" (l.138/243, should be "a doi qubiți"). Finally, "the *reverse*, or in mathematical terms the *inverse*" collapses into the tautological "*inversul*, sau în termeni matematici *inversa*" (l.810), and "Fredkin gate"/"Toffoli gate" come out with calqued English word order as "Gate Fredkin"/"Gate Toffoli" (l.1020, 1032) instead of "poarta Fredkin/Toffoli". None of this misleads a learner.

examples.source: Entanglement is a quintessential feature of quantum information that will be discussed in greater detail in a later lesson.
examples.suggested: Întricarea este o caracteristică esențială a informației cuantice, care va fi discutată mai în detaliu într-o lecție ulterioară.
examples.translation: Întrețeserea (entanglementul) este o caracteristică esențială a informației cuantice, care va fi discutată mai în detaliu într-o lecție ulterioară.
examples.why: The file already teaches the concept as 'stare întricată' (l.176, 189, 217) but switches to 'întrețesere' plus a parenthetical English gloss for the noun in l.187–189 and l.234. Three renderings of the lesson's central term inside one page; pick 'întricare/întricat' and keep it.

examples.source: Not all quantum state vectors of multiple systems are product states.
examples.suggested: Nu toți vectorii de stare cuantică ai sistemelor multiple sunt stări produs.
examples.translation: Nu toate vectorii de stare cuantică ai sistemelor multiple sunt stări produs.
examples.why: 'vector' is masculine, so the quantifier must be 'toți', not 'toate' — a gender-agreement error no Romanian native would write, and it opens the Entangled-states section.

examples.source: of two qubits is not a product state.
examples.suggested: a doi qubiți nu este o stare produs.
examples.translation: al doi qubiti nu este o stare produs.
examples.why: Wrong possessive article plus a missing diacritic ('qubiti'). The same construction recurs at l.243 ('orice vector de stare cuantică al doi qubiti … ale a două biți'), and 'qubit' is additionally spelled 'qubit-uri' at l.394 — three spellings of the field's most basic term in one file.

examples.source: This represents the *reverse*, or in mathematical terms the *inverse*, of the original operation — which is what we expect from the conjugate transpose of a unitary matrix.
examples.suggested: Aceasta reprezintă *inversarea*, sau în termeni matematici *inversa*, operației originale — …
examples.translation: Aceasta reprezintă *inversul*, sau în termeni matematici *inversa*, operației originale — ceea ce ne așteptăm de la transpusa conjugată a unei matrice unitare.
examples.why: The English contrasts the everyday word 'reverse' with the mathematical term 'inverse'; the Romanian uses two inflections of the same word, so the sentence reads as 'the inverse, or mathematically speaking the inverse' — the teaching contrast collapses into a tautology.

examples.source: This operation is also known as a *Fredkin operation,* or more commonly, a *Fredkin gate.*
examples.suggested: Această operațiune mai este cunoscută și sub numele de *operație Fredkin,* sau mai frecvent, *poarta Fredkin.*
examples.translation: Această operațiune mai este cunoscută și sub numele de *operațiune Fredkin,* sau mai frecvent, *Gate Fredkin.*
examples.why: 'Gate Fredkin' keeps English head-noun-first word order, which is ungrammatical in Romanian; the same happens with 'Gate Toffoli' (l.1032). Romanian technical writing uses 'poarta Fredkin/Toffoli'. Note also that the whole trailing section switches from 'operație' (used consistently up to l.928) to 'operațiune'.

editor_note: Paragraph-by-paragraph the meaning is faithful — I found no semantic inversion, no swapped quantity, no dropped caveat and no hallucinated sentence; the load-bearing technical claims (112 qubiți totali din 7 active × 4 pași de timp × 4 qubiți de rezoluție; `population_size ~ 0.8 * n_qubits` ca **minim**; 120 la 84 de qubiți vs 40 la 56; „ordonate de la cea mai mică la cea mai mare valoare a funcției obiectiv”; „linia de bază cu zgomot prezintă o distribuție mai largă”) all match the English exactly, including the dense last 40%. What a native technical editor would still change: (1) QUBO is expanded as „Optimizare Binară Neconstrasă Pătratică” — „Neconstrasă” is not a Romanian word (correct: „neconstrânsă” / „fără constrângeri”), and the word order should be „Optimizare Binară Pătratică Neconstrânsă”; (2) „Sharpe ratio” is rendered two ways in the same file — „Raportul Sharpe” (§5) vs „Indicele Sharpe” (Benchmarks); (3) a gender-agreement slip in the Overview, „Ideală pentru managerii de portofoliu … acest instrument permite” (should be „Ideal … acest instrument”); (4) one formal-register slip, „Rețineți că” in §6, inside a file that otherwise uses consistent informal „tu” („ia lista”, „actualizează coloana”, „compară rezultatele tale”); (5) the alt text on the historical-data image is left untranslated in English while the other two image alt texts are translated; (6) minor calques/imprecisions: „post-procesare conștientă de zgomot”, „linie de bază aleatorie”, „linia … punctată” for *dashed* (punctată = dotted), and „uniformitatea datelor” for „uniformity across dates” (reads as „of the data”, not „across dates”). None of these would cause a learner to form a false belief.

examples.source: a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem
examples.suggested: o problemă de Optimizare Binară Pătratică fără constrângeri (QUBO)
examples.translation: o problemă de Optimizare Binară Neconstrasă Pătratică (QUBO)
examples.why: „Neconstrasă” is a non-word (the correct participle is „neconstrânsă”), and the adjective order separates „Binară” from „Pătratică”. Still recognizable via the QUBO acronym, so it does not mislead — but it is the file's most visible term defect.

examples.source: Sharpe Ratio … The Sharpe ratio, which captures the risk-adjusted return
examples.suggested: Use one rendering throughout — „Indicele Sharpe” (the conventional Romanian finance term) in both places
examples.translation: Raportul Sharpe … Indicele Sharpe, care surprinde randamentul ajustat la risc
examples.why: The same metric is named two different ways within one document; the benchmark table header („Sharpe”) matches neither. Concept stays identifiable, so MINOR.

examples.source: Ideal for portfolio managers, researchers in quantitative finance, and individual investors, this tool enables back-testing of trading strategies
examples.suggested: Ideal pentru managerii de portofoliu, cercetătorii în finanțe cantitative și investitorii individuali, acest instrument permite back-testarea…
examples.translation: Ideală pentru managerii de portofoliu, cercetătorii în finanțe cantitative și investitorii individuali, acest instrument permite back-testarea strategiilor de tranzacționare
examples.why: „Ideală” (feminine, agreeing with „funcția” from the previous sentence) dangles onto „acest instrument” (neuter) — a grammatical agreement break a Romanian writer would not produce.

examples.source: Note that, for better visual comparison, the occurrence counts have been normalized
examples.suggested: Reține că, pentru o mai bună comparație vizuală, …
examples.translation: Rețineți că, pentru o mai bună comparație vizuală, numărătorile de apariții au fost normalizate
examples.why: Isolated formal/plural imperative in a paragraph that is otherwise consistently informal „tu” („ia lista costurilor obiectiv”, „actualizează coloana”). Single slip, so MINOR.

examples.source: In this example, to ensure uniformity across dates, we have filled non-trading days with the closing price from the previous available date.
examples.suggested: …pentru a asigura uniformitatea calendaristică (aceleași date pentru toate activele), am completat zilele fără tranzacționare…
examples.translation: În acest exemplu, pentru a asigura uniformitatea datelor, am completat zilele fără tranzacționare cu prețul de închidere din ziua disponibilă anterioară.
examples.why: „datelor” is ambiguous between „dates” and „data”; the English means alignment across calendar dates, which is what the following sentence about differing market trading days explains. The context rescues it, so it does not mislead.

examples.source: ![Visualization of the historical data of the assets](…assets.avif)
examples.suggested: ![Vizualizarea datelor istorice ale activelor](…assets.avif)
examples.translation: ![Visualization of the historical data of the assets](…assets.avif)
examples.why: Alt text left in English while the other two image alt texts in the file are translated („Vizualizarea fluxului de lucru al funcției”, „Vizualizarea soluției optimizării”) — an accessibility/consistency gap, not a meaning error.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no semantic inversions, no swapped quantities, no hallucinated claims; the delicate passages (the "not a sufficient condition" bolded warning, the Ewin Tang dequantization paragraph, the Liu/Arunachalam/Temme "end-to-end and robust" discussion, the diagonal-entries answer "Diagonalele ar trebui să fie 1.0") all track the English. What a native editor would fix is surface: recurring grammar/spelling slips ("eșantioane neetichete" / "date neetichete" for neetichetate, "superpozitie" for superpoziție ×3, "întrîcarea" for întricarea), one outright mistranslated idiom ("delving into background" → "a intra în fundal", i.e. "to go into the backdrop"), and a register mix that puts formal-plural forms next to informal ones inside the same sentence ("Răspunde la această întrebare … dar rețineți că deviații de la răspunsul tău sunt posibile"; also "imaginați-vă", "Consultați testul"). Terminology is otherwise consistent and defensible (nucleu/matricea nucleului, hărți de caracteristici, stări întricate, decuantizare), but "inner product" is rendered as the calque "produs intern" instead of the standard "produs scalar", and "kernel matrix entry" alternates between "element al matricei nucleului" (§Run your first QML code) and "intrare a matricei nucleului" / "intrările diagonale" (§Check your understanding).

examples.source: It is often helpful to see where we're going, before breaking it down into pieces, and delving into background.
examples.suggested: … înainte de a descompune totul în bucăți și de a intra în detaliile teoretice.
examples.translation: Este adesea util să vedem unde mergem, înainte de a descompune totul în bucăți și a intra în fundal.
examples.why: "delving into background" is rendered literally as "a intra în fundal" (= to step into the backdrop/background image), which is meaningless in Romanian and reads as raw MT.

examples.source: Answer this question in the absence of noise, but note that deviations from your answer are possible in the presence of noise.
examples.suggested: Răspunde la această întrebare în absența zgomotului, dar reține că deviații de la răspunsul tău sunt posibile în prezența zgomotului.
examples.translation: Răspunde la această întrebare în absența zgomotului, dar rețineți că deviații de la răspunsul tău sunt posibile în prezența zgomotului.
examples.why: Informal "Răspunde"/"tău" collides with formal-plural "rețineți" in the same sentence; same slip at "imaginați-vă un algoritm" (§Dequantization) and "Consultați testul" (§Course structure), against the file's otherwise consistent "tu".

examples.source: Many processes in machine learning use inner products as part of binary classification … estimates the inner product in that space
examples.suggested: … folosesc produse scalare … estimăm produsul scalar în acel spațiu
examples.translation: Multe procese din machine learning folosesc produse interne ca parte a clasificării binare … estimăm produsul intern în acel spațiu
examples.why: "produs intern" is a calque of "inner product"; the conventional Romanian mathematical/physics term is "produs scalar" (or "produs interior"). Recognizable, so not misleading, but not the field's term.

examples.source: unsupervised learning, in which the algorithm attempts to learn about a distribution from unlabeled samples … the unsupervised process starts with unlabeled data
examples.suggested: …din eșantioane neetichetate … începe cu date neetichetate
examples.translation: …algoritmul încearcă să învețe despre o distribuție din eșantioane neetichete … procesul nesupervizat începe cu date neetichete
examples.why: "neetichete" is not a Romanian word; the correct participial adjective is "neetichetate". Repeated twice, in a paragraph that is defining the supervised/unsupervised contrast.

examples.source: There are many other differences that will be discussed in future lessons, including entanglement and interference.
examples.suggested: …inclusiv întricarea și interferența.
examples.translation: Există multe alte diferențe care vor fi discutate în lecțiile viitoare, inclusiv întrîcarea și interferența.
examples.why: Misspelling "întrîcarea" (stray circumflex) of the term the file otherwise renders correctly as "întricate"/"întricate" (e.g. "stărilor cuantice întricate"); also "superpozitie" appears three times without the ț diacritic.

editor_note: The save_account step inverts a security-relevant instruction: EN "([Skip to the next step](#functions-untrusted) if you are not using a trusted environment...)" — i.e. jump ahead TO step 3 — is rendered "[Laktawan ang susunod na hakbang](#functions-untrusted)", which in Tagalog means "SKIP/omit the next step". A reader on a shared or public computer is thereby told to omit exactly the step (step 3, "Iwasang mag-execute ng code sa isang hindi pinagkakatiwalaang makina...") that contains the untrusted-environment and API-key-rotation guidance; the correct rendering is "Lumaktaw sa susunod na hakbang" / "Tumungo sa susunod na hakbang". Beyond that the file is faithful and the domain terms are handled sensibly and consistently (circuit function, error mitigation, expectation values, shots, observable, Sampler/Estimator kept in English; transpilation kept; "Mga workload na may low-weight observable at loop-free na circuit"). Remaining defects are minor: "nililigtas ng Qiskit Functions ang oras" for "free up time" reads as calque ("rescues the time"), "maaari kang kunin ang result data" should be "maaari mong kunin", and "binabawasan ang panganib at pinalaki ang kita" mixes aspects ("pinapalaki" expected).

examples.source: ([Skip to the next step](#functions-untrusted) if you are not using a trusted environment, such as a shared or public computer, to authenticate to IBM Quantum Platform.)
examples.suggested: ([Lumaktaw sa susunod na hakbang](#functions-untrusted) kung hindi ka gumagamit ng pinagkakatiwalaang environment, ...)
examples.translation: ([Laktawan ang susunod na hakbang](#functions-untrusted) kung hindi ka gumagamit ng pinagkakatiwalaang environment, tulad ng shared o pampublikong computer, para ma-authenticate sa IBM Quantum Platform.)
examples.why: "Skip TO the next step" (go ahead to step 3) becomes "laktawan ang susunod na hakbang" = omit the next step. This tells a user on a public/shared computer to skip the very step that carries the untrusted-environment setup and the instruction to delete the API key after each use — an inverted, security-relevant directive.

examples.source: Qiskit Functions free up time normally spent hand-writing code and fine-tuning experiments.
examples.suggested: nakakatipid ang Qiskit Functions sa oras na karaniwang ginugugol sa manu-manong pagsulat ng code at pag-fine-tune ng mga eksperimento.
examples.translation: nililigtas ng Qiskit Functions ang oras na karaniwang ginagastos sa pagsulat ng code nang manu-mano at pag-aayos ng mga eksperimento.
examples.why: "nililigtas ang oras" literally means "rescues the time"; no Tagalog technical writer would say this for "free up time" — "nakakatipid ng oras" / "nagpapalaya ng oras" is the natural phrasing. Also "ginagastos" collocates with money more than time ("ginugugol").

examples.source: **`DONE`**: The program is complete, and you can retrieve result data with `job.results()`.
examples.suggested: ... at maaari mong kunin ang result data gamit ang `job.results()`.
examples.translation: **`DONE`**: Tapos na ang program, at maaari kang kunin ang result data gamit ang `job.results()`.
examples.why: Focus/pronoun mismatch: with the object-focus verb "kunin" the actor must be genitive ("mo"), not nominative ("ka"). As written it reads as "you can be fetched" — a grammatical slip a native editor would fix on sight.

examples.source: seeking optimal portfolio strategies over time while minimizing risk and maximizing returns
examples.suggested: ... habang binabawasan ang panganib at pinapalaki ang kita
examples.translation: na naghahanap ng optimal na portfolio strategy sa paglipas ng panahon habang binabawasan ang panganib at pinalaki ang kita
examples.why: Aspect mismatch inside one coordinated clause: "binabawasan" is imperfective (ongoing) but "pinalaki" is perfective (already done), so the parallel breaks. Minor, but a native technical editor would align them.

editor_note: Three meaning-level errors would mislead a learner. (1) "simulate" is rendered as "simulan" (to START) in three places — the Use Case 1 heading "Pagsimula ng hadron dynamics", "bakit ... ang pagsimula nito sa isang quantum computer ay gagana", and worst, "ang mga interaksyon ng mga particle na ito ay maaaring masimula mula simula hanggang katapusan", which literally claims a quantum computer could START the particle interactions; the rest of the file correctly uses "i-simulate"/"simulasyon", so the split is an error, not a convention. (2) In the spin-glass definition, "the spins behave as a glass" becomes "kumilos bilang isang salamin" (behave as a MIRROR), and "magnetic moments" becomes "magnetic na sandali" (magnetic INSTANTS of time) — two false-friend renderings in the one sentence that defines the object of Use Case 2. (3) "Shor's and Grover's are two of only a handful of examples" becomes "ay isa sa ilang halimbawa lamang" (one). Lesser slips: "the game Sudoku" → "ang laruan na Sudoku" (toy), "counteract" → "nagtatapat", "dedicated their careers" → "nagtukoy ng kanilang mga karera", the non-word "pagkakaultrap" for getting stuck in local minima, the typo "klasseng", and the dropped hedge "theoretically" on Grover's algorithm.

examples.source: In some regimes, the model predicts that the spins behave as a glass, in which the magnetic moments are disordered above a so-called "freezing temperature."
